Question B-008-002-009.

Why the correct answer is right: Shorter speaker leads pick up less RF because there is less wire acting as an unintended antenna.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Lengthen the leads": Longer leads usually make RF pickup worse by providing more conductor length to intercept the field.
- sourceIndex 2: "Connect the speakers through audio attenuators": Audio attenuators reduce sound level, but they do not remove the RF being collected by the speaker wiring.
- sourceIndex 3: "Connect the speakers through series capacitors": Series capacitors would alter the speaker circuit and are not the standard way to reduce RF pickup by long leads.
